(a national banking association) for substantially all client accounts, and Corvedale Clay Securities, LLC (an SEC-registered broker-dealer) for a limited number of accounts requiring securities-based lines of credit or option strategies on concentrated positions. Independent public accountant performing the annual surprise custody examination: Aldwick Brennan LLP.","source_document":"01_brochure.md","section":"Item 15. Custody > 15.1 Qualified Custodians; Item 15. Custody > 15.3 Surprise Examination","quote":"Client assets are held by Norrell Bay Trust & Custody, N.A., a national banking association, which serves as the qualified custodian for substantially all client accounts. A limited number of accounts, principally accounts that require securities-based lines of credit or option strategies on concentrated positions, are held at Corvedale Clay Securities, LLC, a broker-dealer registered with the SEC. ... The Firm engages Aldwick Brennan LLP, an independent public accountant, to conduct an annual surprise examination of client funds and securities over which the Firm or a related person has custody by reason of trustee appointments, individual appointments of employees or bill payment authority."}
